name: Hachiban Kareshi
source:
Point out the changes in your boyfriend Yahata-kun!
If you fail, you get reset back to August 1st and Yahata-kun's pattern changes.

※Find things about Yahata-kun that are different from yesterday.
※The changes aren't random. Sorry.

"Let's make a game with a strong female protagonist" is what I initially planned at the start, so there IS girl x boy romance. All boys in the game are passive (This is what the creator decided, so it must be true.)
translation:
指出你男朋友八幡君的变化！
如果你失败了，你就会回到8月1日，八幡君的模式也会改变。

※发现八幡君与昨天不同的事情。
※变更不是随机的。对不起。

“让我们做一个有强势女主角的游戏吧”是我一开始的计划，所以就有了女孩x男孩的浪漫。游戏中的所有男孩都是被动的（这是创作者决定的，所以这一定是真的。）
